answer: Every new agent must burn a 400-credit join bond before its first vertex can link in, irreversibly: a knoll of idle fakes gains nothing, since each live identity starts 400 in the red. 1,000 sybils burn 400,000 credits up front, while one honest agent recoups it from 2,600 credits of work within three epochs, so the attack costs more than any single-epoch reward. The ripple stays contained because each new vertex pays the same full burn. Edge case: a genuine newcomer priced out by the fee can enter sponsored, with an attestor staking 200 credits lost if they misbehave within five epochs.
